answer: The strongest lever is simple: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because ripple only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, glacier is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any timber approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
